archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (adapted for local reliable business)

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary dark:text-white
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary dark:text-white

buttons.primary: bg-[#F5A623] hover:bg-[#D98E1C] text-[#0F172A] font-bold px-6 py-3 rounded-md transition-all shadow-lg shadow-[#F5A623]/20
buttons.secondary: bg-[#0D1F3C] hover:bg-[#162B50] text-white font-bold px-6 py-3 rounded-md transition-all
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#0D1F3C] text-[#0D1F3C] hover:bg-[#0D1F3C] hover:text-white font-bold px-6 py-3 rounded-md transition-all

cards.base: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow p-6
cards.dark: bg-[#162B50] border border-[#1E3A8A] rounded-xl text-white p-6

inputs.base: w-full border-slate-300 rounded-md shadow-sm focus:ring-[#F5A623] focus:border-[#F5A623] bg-white

layout.nav: Sticky header, bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 z-50
layout.hero: Dark navy background (#0D1F3C) with image overlay (black/40). Yellow accent CTA. Prominent phone number.
layout.bento_grid: Use asymmetrical bento grids for 'Über uns' or highlights.

icons.style: stroke-width 2, color matching primary or accent depending on background

animations.hover: Subtle translation (-translate-y-1) and shadow increase on cards
animations.entrance: Staggered fade-up for grid items using framer-motion

image_urls.description: Electrician working on power pole - use as Hero Background with dark navy overlay
Yellow, blue and black coated wires - use for services or general electrical imagery
Bochum city building - use for 'Einzugsgebiet' (Service area) or Über uns section
Electrician in gear - use to represent Marco Hofer or the team

media.logo_instructions: Use the provided logo context: HOFER logo with red lightning bolt on black background. For headers, if the header is light, either invert the logo or use a dark navbar to accommodate the black background logo. Or recreate the logo text 'HOFER' with an inline red lightning bolt icon.

pages_and_features: Home: Hero with CTA/Phone, Services Teaser, Trust Signals (Meisterbetrieb, Seit 2002), CTA.
Leistungen: Full services page, grid layout with icons, descriptions.
Über uns: About Marco Hofer, 30 years experience, local focus.
Kontakt: Display-only form, address, map placeholder.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button')
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG standards, especially over images or dark navy backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML and Tailwind for marketing layouts (Hero, Features).
Use Shadcn UI for forms, inputs, and standard UI elements like Dialogs or Tabs if needed.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use the designated 'Outfit' font.
Apply `p-6` or `p-8` to cards to ensure generous spacing.
Adhere to the exact color palette: Primary #0D1F3C, Accent #F5A623.
